prompt.content:
You are generating synthetic enterprise support ticket text for a dataset used to train and evaluate support-case classification systems. For each case in the input JSON array, write a realistic support ticket TITLE and DESCRIPTION as the customer would write it — not as an engineer would describe the internal diagnosis.

Vary sentence structure, technical sophistication, length, clarity, and tone across cases. Some customers are precise; some are rambling, use shorthand, misspell things, or bury the important detail in the third sentence. Never state the internal root cause, resolution type, issue subcategory, or team name verbatim — those are back-office labels the customer has never seen. Only reference the symptoms, environment, impact, and (if given) the customer's own theory/misdiagnosis.

Follow the "narrative_instruction" field for each case exactly.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"cases": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every case index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'product_customer_sees': 'SSO Integration Module', 'environment': 'production', 'region': 'ANZ', 'symptoms_observed': ['HTTP 401', 'password reset email missing'], 'reported_business_impact': 'critical', 'reported_affected_users': 4189, 'narrative_instruction': 'Write a clear, reasonably well-organized ticket. The customer describes what they observed accurately and with enough detail to act on.'}]

response: {"cases": [{"i": 0, "title": "Critical: 4189 Users Blocked from SSO Login (HTTP 401) and No Password Reset Emails", "description": "We are currently facing a critical outage in our production environment (ANZ region) affecting approximately 4,189 users. Starting this morning, everyone attempting to log in via the SSO Integration Module is receiving an HTTP 401 Unauthorized error. Additionally, we have a secondary issue where users who might be able to bypass the SSO or are locked out are not receiving any password reset emails, making it impossible for them to regain access independently. This is completely halting operations for our entire APAC workforce. Please treat this as high priority."}]}
